summary: Iteration 4 focused re-test of the ONLY critical bug from iteration 3 (Bulk Research route collision). FIX VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend: pytest TestBulk 4/4 pass including test_bulk_research_capped (removed xfail, updated endpoint to /leads/batch-research); ran in 48s and actually researched a real lead via Claude + web fetch. curl smoke: old /leads/bulk/research → 404 (route removed, expected), new /leads/batch-research → 200 with {researched,requested}. Frontend UI: /leads → select 1 checkbox → bulk-bar appears → click bulk-research → window.confirm accepted → POST /api/leads/batch-research 200 → green sonner toast 'Researched 0/1' (0 because selected lead was already Researched; endpoint correctly skips them). No 'Failed' toast. Other bulk routes (/leads/bulk/assign, /leads/bulk/campaign, /leads/bulk/delete) regressed clean (pytest TestBulk::test_bulk_assign/campaign/delete all pass). Dashboard Recent Activity shows 'Researched TEST_BULK_RESEARCH_1 (bulk)' confirming AI+web path works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:414 bulk_research uses cap=3 with a hard-coded slice [:3]. Because each lead is ~30s of AI+web work and the ingress cuts at ~100s, 3 is a safe upper bound today — but if the AI service or ingress limits change, this cap should become a config constant. Consider adding a top-line comment or module constant BULK_RESEARCH_CAP = 3.

server.py:414 endpoint path /leads/batch-research is a single-segment sibling of /leads/{lead_id}/... so it will never collide again. Good. Still worth adding a code comment above the route explaining why the /bulk/ prefix was avoided, to prevent a future contributor from re-introducing the collision.

server.py bulk_research still silently swallows per-lead exceptions (logger.warning only). Frontend cannot tell WHICH lead failed. Consider returning failed_ids in the payload so the UI can show a richer toast (previously flagged, still open).
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown handlers — cosmetic, replace with FastAPI lifespan before next major FastAPI upgrade (carried over).

rca of the issue: PREVIOUS BUG (FIXED): FastAPI matches routes in declaration order. In iteration 3, POST /leads/{lead_id}/research (line 249) was declared BEFORE POST /leads/bulk/research (line 414), so 'bulk' was captured as lead_id → 404. FIX APPLIED by E1: renamed the bulk endpoint to POST /leads/batch-research — a single-segment sibling of /leads/{lead_id}/... which cannot collide. Also lowered cap 6→3 because each lead consumes ~30s of AI+web time and the preview ingress cuts around 100s. Verified via curl (200, researched:0/requested:0 on empty list; 200, researched:1/requested:1 on unresearched leads) and via pytest (test_bulk_research_capped actually researched 1 real lead through Claude+web_research). Frontend AllLeads.jsx line 55 already posts to the new /leads/batch-research path.
